name: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. engages in natural gas distribution activities in Ankara. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey. Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a subsidiary of Torunlar Enerji Sanayi Ve Tic.A.S.
